observations: Third-reader verified inventory. All 4 original screenshots (1366 px wide; 589, 582, 590 and 586 px high), the 8 pre-rendered zooms and 20 additional tight crops (prefix c in the zoom folder) were read. Readers A and B agreed on every report, section, control, option list, default value, enabled state and truncation flag (4 reports, 35 sections, 50 controls); their differences were note wording only. Every point was nevertheless re-checked on the pixels: the selected list radio of every file, blue-mark detection for every chosen criteria radio and ticked checkbox, fill colours of every input box, glyph dumps of the disputed header letters and of the dropdown / date values, vertical colour profiles of the option rows at the bottom of each criteria panel, and an ink-cluster map of every criteria panel, the title bar and the panel header bar. Nothing exists beyond the controls listed here: no tiny right-edge checkbox (no 'Page Break'), no GROUP BY / SORT BY, no extra column of controls, no greyed-out control, no instruction / warning / legend text, no scrollbar on either panel, no footer text. COVERAGE: 4 screenshots = 4 different reports, one screenshot each, in list order (1.PNG = Treatment Plan Proposal, 2.PNG = Treatment Plan Status, 3.PNG = Treatment Plan Analysis, 4.PNG = Treatment Plan Detail); every listed report has a screenshot. All four are the same two-panel screen in its normal state - no popup, no expanded dropdown, no scrolled second view, no foreign screen - so the contents of every SELECT dialog (Office, Office Group, Provider, Exclude Patient Type, Codes, Exclude Treatment Plans, TX Counselor), of the two name SEARCH lookups and of the FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE dropdown list are NOT documented by these screenshots. TITLE BAR (identical in all 4): 'Treatment Plan Reports' at the left; 'PGID :2829 / OID :108' followed by a white printer icon (no text) at the far right. LEFT PANEL: blue header 'SELECT REPORT'; exactly 4 reports as radio buttons in a 2 x 2 grid (left column: Treatment Plan Proposal, Treatment Plan Status; right column: Treatment Plan Analysis, Treatment Plan Detail). The rest of the panel is one uniform dark-blue colour down to the bottom edge, so the list is complete - not scrollable, nothing clipped. A splitter / collapse handle (three vertical dots) sits on the border between the two panels. RIGHT PANEL: blue header 'REPORT CRITERIA' with the slate-grey CLEAR CRITERIA button (refresh icon) at its right end - grey is its normal style on this screen, not a disabled state; a docked bar at the bottom right of the criteria panel holds the blue buttons PRINT / PREVIEW (printer icon) and ADD TO MY FAVORITES (plus icon). COMMON TO ALL 4 REPORTS: PRINT FORMAT (PDF / Excel, default PDF); OFFICE/GROUP (Office / Office Group radios, default Office, plus an unlabelled office picker showing 108 = the OID); PROVIDER (picker labelled 'Provider', value ALL); DIAGNOSED DATE RANGE (Start Date and End Date, both 11/21/2026 - apparently the capture day, i.e. default = current date; the date range is always titled DIAGNOSED DATE RANGE in this category); EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE (picker, None); an OTHER OPTIONS checkbox section. REPORT-SPECIFIC: Treatment Plan Proposal adds NAME RANGE (Start Name AAAAA / End Name ZZZZZ, each with a SEARCH button), TREATMENT PLAN ID, PHASE ID, ORDER ID (three empty text boxes), a FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE dropdown (value '.Treatment Plan Disclosure', with a leading period) and four print-oriented checkboxes (Include Office UCR and Itemize Prices ticked; Include Completed Procedures and Print Responsible Party Address not ticked). Treatment Plan Status adds REPORT FORMAT (Detail / Summary, default Detail), the TREATMENT PLANS status radio grid (ALL default plus 10 statuses), EXCLUDE TREATMENT PLANS (None), CODES (ALL), TX COUNSELOR (ALL) and the checkbox 'Include internal plan id'. Treatment Plan Detail adds CODES (box empty). 'Include Inactive Patients' (unticked) is visible on Status, Analysis and Detail but not in the visible part of Proposal. TRUNCATION: the criteria area is a fixed-height viewport (about 482 px) with the action bar docked directly under it and no scrollbar drawn. In 1.PNG the top 5 px of a third, full-width OTHER OPTIONS row are visible before the action bar hides it, and in 2.PNG the second OTHER OPTIONS row is cut at its lower edge, so Treatment Plan Proposal and Treatment Plan Status are flagged possibly_truncated - more options may exist below that these screenshots do not show. 3.PNG and 4.PNG end with about 140 px of empty background and are complete. ICONS AND FILLS: building icon on the SELECT buttons of the office, CODES and EXCLUDE TREATMENT PLANS pickers; single-person icon on Provider; person-plus icon on EXCLUDE PATIENT TYPE and TX COUNSELOR; magnifier on SEARCH; calendar icon inside the date boxes; chevron on the dropdown. Picker value boxes use a darker grey read-only fill (RGB 220,223,226) while the name, ID and date boxes and the dropdown use the lighter editable fill (RGB 241,241,241). TYPING CONVENTION (same as the other category files): a light editable box followed by a SEARCH button is recorded as text_input plus a separate button control; a grey read-only box followed by SELECT is recorded as one picker. HEADER FONT: in the grey section-header bars the capital G is drawn almost like a C, so the headers look like 'OFFICE/CROUP', 'DIACNOSED DATE RANCE' and 'NAME RANCE' at normal zoom; the glyph differs from a true C only by a slightly heavier lower-right terminal, and the normal-text radio label 'Office Group' shows a clear G, so the titles are transcribed as OFFICE/GROUP, DIAGNOSED DATE RANGE and NAME RANGE. All controls in all four reports appear enabled.
